gen.title: Steps to propose and ratify amendments
gen.orderNote: Arrange the actions from earliest demand to final ratification

steps.label: Opponents warn about tyranny
steps.quote: its opponents repeatedly charged that the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny by the central government.

steps.label: Citizens demand bill of rights protections
steps.quote: They demanded a "bill of rights" that would spell out the immunities of individual citizens.

steps.label: State conventions request amendments
steps.quote: Several state conventions in their formal ratification of the Constitution asked for such amendments

steps.label: Congress proposes amendments to states
steps.quote: On September 25, 1789, the First Congress of the United States therefore proposed to the state legislatures 12 amendments to the Constitution

steps.label: States ratify amendments as bill of rights
steps.quote: Articles 3 to 12, ratified December 15, 1791, by three-fourths of the state legislatures, constitute the first 10 amendments of the Constitution,
